extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/jobs/view/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: (a.closest('.job-card-list__title') || a.closest('.base-card') || a).innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).filter(x => x.href.includes('/jobs/view/')).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)

param_reference.f_E: 2 = Associate, 3 = Mid-Senior; use 2,3 for 1-3 yr range

rules: Substitute {KEYWORD} from prompt role filters — one search_urls entry per keyword group (max 3-4 per run)
First search IS the health check — if links < min_links, run failure ladder
Verify finalists with WebFetch OR browser listing page — never both on same URL
WebSearch site:linkedin.com/jobs only if all search_urls yield < 3 total candidates
Do not repeat the same search URL twice in one pass
notes: Requires LinkedIn login in Cursor Browser for search pages
